messages:
marco_infra: FYI seeing an ECC error spike on eu-west-2 gpool-7. 6 cards flagged over ~2h, concentrated on gpuhost-12.
sasha_ops: dashboard -> https://redwood.internal/metrics/gpu?pool=gpool-7 (looks like errors clustered by slot).
lee_hw: logs show repeated Xid 13 + ECC single-bit then DBE on two cards. temps around mid-80s.
marco_infra: I set those two GPUs to drain_immediate but kept jobs running on remaining capacity — no customer impact so far.
anna_sre: can we preemptively allocate spares from D-staging? want to avoid a reactive hot-swap if they degrade more.
sasha_ops: STG-B has 4 compatible spares. serials available: SN-93A2, SN-93A3, SN-93B1, SN-93B2.
marco_infra: opened vendor case CASE-51072 with attachments (nvsm logs + photos). tagging vendor/expedite.
vendor-portal-bot: CASE-51072 created (priority: expedited) https://vendor.internal/cases/51072
lee_hw: before swapping, let's run a memtest+fvcheck on gpuhost-12 gpus 2-3. run: `sudo nvdiag --run memtest --gpu 2,3 --duration 30m`
marco_infra: paste of nvdiag summary:
```
[gpuhost-12] nvdiag memtest --gpu 2
ECC errors: 142 reads, 9 DBE
Temperature: 77C average (spike to 86C during workload)
GPU reset count: 4
PCI link flaps: 2
```
sasha_ops: request approval: allocate 2 spares SN-93A2,SN-93A3 from STG-B -> eu-west-2 pool, standard depot courier (24-36h).
anna_sre: +1 for preemptive swap. please label kitting "hot-swap" and add short runbook.
marco_infra: added serials to internal manifest: https://docs.internal/ops/gpu-spare-manifest (entry: SN-93A2,SN-93A3, dest=eu-west-2, purpose=preemptive).
ops-bot: manifest updated by marco_infra at 2134567860
lee_hw: note: do NOT reseat cards before vendor decision — previous batch had connector wear that reseating masked briefly. prefer full bench replacement.
sasha_ops: booked courier AWB 1Z9999EUW, manifest ETA 2025-08-12T09:30Z. I'll create a Zendesk RMA ticket to log serial swaps.
marco_infra: plan: maintenance window 2025-08-12 10:00-10:30Z for drain + swap. we'll route 10% traffic to canary for 30m after swap. notifying oncall now.
anna_sre: adding canary policy: initial 10% traffic, health-checks every 30s, monitor ECC & resets for 72h.
sasha_ops: RMA log entry: SN-83C7 -> replaced with SN-93A2, SN-84D1 -> replaced with SN-93A3. will attach proof of delivery and vendor RMA closing notes.
marco_infra: follow-up: create a short regression eval job (small generated workload) to run on replaced cards for 6h post-swap. add to weekly health report.
lee_hw: sounds good. i'll keep an eye on Xid counts and PCI link flaps. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: monitor ECC for 72h after 2134568000 (task id T-73821)
marco_infra: thanks team — keep updates minimal in this thread unless something changes, we'll open a new postmortem if repeat failures show up.
